The four screen traces cite local photographs #49–52.
This component sheet derives from those measured traces.
The bar sheet is original; it has no source photograph.
Its borrowed silhouettes and color samples cite the traces.
Outlines and text use local, measured ink values.
No universal kitsch stroke width is asserted here.
Default style values do not describe every custom path.
Current bar style: chevrons, stepped cells, bracket, wave.
Rust maps these style choices through src/bar.rs.
Historical bar validation is recorded in todo/bar.md.
This sheet does not claim pixel parity with runtime.
Hover and press examples are inferred, not photographed.
The login caret is visible; no mouse pointer is shown.
See source-citations.md for paths and coordinate evidence.

also measured: band #fec32f . grown card #ffc233 . EVENTS #f5cb23 . mail tab #fbd42c . row #e8c21f . DETAILS #e6c020 . outlines #f2c825 / #e2a408 . badge #f0a93c . ghost #0f9f80
1 . Line-work is 1.25px centred on .5 coordinates. The only exceptions measured: 2.0 for letter boxes, 1.0 for security badges, 1.8 for a fan card.
2 . Rounded AND chamfered: r8 (fan card, chip, panel foot), r6 (card top-left), r2..3, r30..40 (bracket); chamfers on the card top-right, band end, chevron end and tab.
9 . A rose bloom sits over the TOP of every screen, brightest at top centre, gone by y 420; every screen ends with the same centred mint foot line at y 870.
3 . Yellow means SELECTED, never alarm: SMG, EVENTS, DETAILS, list row 1, badge 02, card 2. Everything else is teal line-work.
4 . Selection is not always a fill. Card 2 is amber-filled above and amber-OUTLINED below; the message panel is a yellow outline under a solid tab.
5 . A selected cell keeps its silhouette exactly and swaps fill for outline; no era screen grows or moves a cell to select it.
6 . One solid teal wave per screen, at the foot of the container where its left edge forks (store 575..718, mail 606..748).
7 . Container lines FADE where they leave the frame rather than stopping square; bars step 7..9px over a 12px diagonal.
8 . Micro-text is STRETCHED, not tracked: notes x1.3, labels x1.37, boxed caps x1.7. Every glyph is Rajdhani.
NOT SOURCED: no still in the kitsch run (#44..52) shows a pointer, a lit sibling or a held cell; the run is rest frames. REST is sourced; HOVER and PRESS are INFERRED from the era's own emphasis:

#45 stands the fan up as physical slabs, the selected one ~1.5x taller (body 54px vs 36px, sampled), and #49 extrudes every blade (+20,-20) . so HOVER = LIFT (one ghost step), PRESS = the selection fill arriving FLAT
BUTTON rest = the login ENTER bar (#50), 335x35.3 #8afada ink #0f3a33 . HOVER: face unchanged,
one ghost (+20,-20) #0f9f80 .58 / #6cc4bd 1.2 .80 . PRESS: no ghost, fill #ffbe18 ink #5a3a08
the era changes a cell's fill or its depth, never its silhouette; hover is depth, press is fill
FIELD 334.6x50.4, rounded 8px step, #162826 . REST: the plate alone (inferred: #50 shows the field
focused only) . HOVER: the same plate + one ghost (+20,-20) . PRESS = FOCUS, sourced: the
2x22 #8af0d8 caret at +9,+8 arrives and blinks (login-trace #caret-blink), ghost gone
NAV CHEVRON 216x39 . REST outline 1.25 #5fd6c2 ink #7fe0c8 . HOVER: the fan's idle
face, #2c9798 / #a9e6df 1.8 / ink #123c38, + one ghost (+20,-20) . PRESS: #ffbe18 ink
#5a3a08, no ghost . the tab chevron (161x46) and fan blade take the same three states
